main.description: List the repos in a space's writer set, with the latest known state of each: its current revision, or its removal from the writer set. Requires a space credential, implemented by the space host.

cursor.description: Return repos updated after this space revision. Removed repos may be garbage collected after 72 hrs, so a syncer whose last seen space revision is older should list the whole writer set instead.

repos.description: The latest update to each repo, ordered by spaceRev, ascending. prevSpaceRev is not set.

errors.name: RepoTakendown
errors.description: The space authority has been taken down.

errors.name: RepoDeactivated
errors.description: The space authority has been deactivated.
